sources.title: Resonant ultrasound spectroscopy: The essential toolbox
sources.authors: F. F. Balakirev, S. M. Ennaceur, R. J. Migliori, B. Maiorov, A. Migliori
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and introduction in primary publisher HTML
sources.supports: RUS measures multiple mechanical normal modes and depends on the specimen's shape, density and elasticity.
sources.limit: Tutorial focuses on cylinders and rectangular specimens; not a direct copper-position experiment.

sources.title: Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy for Irregularly Shaped Samples and Its Application to Uranium Ditelluride
sources.reading_depth: Methods, measurement uncertainty, and Supplement VII.5
sources.supports: Finite mounting force and orientation contribute to the uncertainty; remounting is an experimental control.
sources.limit: Published 2024 source. HTML also displays a later generated date; canonical version is arXiv v2 dated 12 March 2024. Numerical values are not applied to copper.

sources.title: The effect of gas loading on the RUS spectra of spheres
sources.authors: R. S. Sorbello, J. Feller, M. Levy, D. G. Isaak, J. D. Carnes, O. L. Anderson
sources.venue: Journal of the Acoustical Society of America 107, 808–818
sources.reading_depth: Primary article abstract indexed by PubMed
sources.supports: Sphere resonance frequencies and Q respond to gas-loading conditions; model agreement is mode-dependent.
sources.limit: Fused silica at elevated gas pressures, not copper at ambient pressure.

sources.title: Accuracy of Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy: An Experimental Study
sources.authors: M. C. Renken, S. A. Kim, K. W. Hollman, C. M. Fortunko
sources.reading_depth: NIST primary publication record and abstract
sources.supports: Independent measurement methods can test the accuracy of RUS-derived quantities.
sources.limit: Accuracy is specific to its fused-silica specimen and apparatus; not a promise for the new experiment.

sources.title: Evaluation of measurement data: Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
sources.authors: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
sources.reading_depth: Sections 4 and 5 of the accessible standard text
sources.supports: Use sensitivities and covariances in the combined uncertainty; correlated inputs cannot always be combined as independent terms.
sources.limit: Linearized uncertainty propagation requires checking its approximation and coverage assumptions.

sources.title: Experimental Modal Analysis
sources.supports: FRF fitting, stabilization, MAC and coherence are supported modal-analysis diagnostics.
sources.limit: Vendor documentation, not peer-reviewed evidence of a location effect; software is not asserted to be open source.
